grains.RAW.SITES: one row per fictional remittance pickup site (city, format, risk tier)
grains.RAW.SITE_DAILY: one row per site per day (90 days)
grains.RAW.PARTNER_DOCUMENTS: one row per site (partner accreditation document snapshot)

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day programme-wide blocker-volume FORECAST; eKYC error rate ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.ONBOARDING_SOP_SEARCH over synthetic onboarding-blocker SOPs (one per site format and blocker type)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.INCLUSION_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.INCLUSION_OPS_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; the action memo uses only KPI, site, blocker-type and risk rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (sites, daily blockers, abandoned applications by site, abandoned-application risk, pickup events loaded) through a read-only Snowflake service user
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: Amazon Data Firehose -> S3 -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_PICKUPS
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_BLOCKER_ALERT logs new BLOCKER events to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)
required_capabilities.dropout_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(abandoned-application blocker at the site in the next 7 days), evaluated on an out-of-time holdout
